title: 实盘 dry_run 护栏 (live_trading_manager) — 重点验证 F-N01-1 CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED 兜底
standing_caveat: 护栏铁律遵守: 全程仅 dry_run 预览或被护栏拦截, 无任何真实下单(broker gateway not configured + read_only mode + write_enabled=false, 三层保证); confirm_token 即使提供也因网关只读不会成交

tool_status_rows.extra: ★15 action + action_params(submit_order required/optional)+safety_notes('写操作默认dry_run=true; execute=true必须配confirm_token'); doc明确
★configured=false/connected=false/read_only=true/write_enabled=false/allow_write=false; provider=alpaca paper; 多重只读护栏标志; monitor是gateway_status别名
★gateway未配置→'live broker gateway not configured' success=false 优雅; 只读类不伪造数据
★★dry_run预览: accepted=true/submitted=false/mode=dry_run/'已生成下单预览'; preview完整(symbol/side/qty/type/tif); sanity_warnings(qty非100整数倍); 不触达broker

★★★F-N01-1兜底验证成功! error_code=CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED+'confirmation required: provide confirm_token=I_UNDERSTAND_THE_RISK'; ★meta.side_effect运行时正确标 level=trade_risk/confirmation_required=true(纠正了契约里read_only的错误标注F-N01-1)

tool_status_rows.tool: submit_order(execute=true, 正确confirm_token) 网关只读兜底
tool_status_rows.extra: ★★★第三层护栏: 即便confirm_token=I_UNDERSTAND_THE_RISK+execute=true, 因网关write_enabled=false→mode=read_only/submitted=false/'网关处于只读模式,返回下单预览'; 绝不真实下单; buy/sell均如此
★缺qty/notional→'qty/quantity or notional is required'; 缺symbol→'symbol/code is required'; 缺type默认market; 校验先于gateway检查
⚠ dry_run预览 qty=-50→accepted=true, sanity_warnings仅提示lot_size(非100整数倍)未提示负数量; 负qty未被sanity拦截(dry_run阶段) (F-N35-1)
★notional=5000(按金额)/limit_price=150 sell/market均正确生成预览, time_in_force=day默认
★需gateway的操作均'gateway not configured'优雅; mirror_to_paper(dry_run)/sync_order_events 不崩溃
★缺order_id→'order_id is required'(参数校验); 带order_id→gateway未配置报错

findings.title: submit_order dry_run 预览阶段不校验负数量
findings.evidence: submit_order(dry_run=true, qty=-50, side=buy)→accepted=true, sanity_warnings 仅含 'lot_size:qty=-50 not multiple of 100', 未对负数量(qty<0)给出 sanity 警告或拒绝。preview 照常生成 qty=-50。
findings.impact: dry_run 阶段负数量未被 sanity check 标记, 虽然真实下单会被 broker 拒(且网关只读), 但预览给出负数量订单会误导。建议 sanity check 增加正负校验。低危(被多层护栏兜底, 实盘不会成交)。

positive_notes: ★★★ F-N01-1 运行时兜底验证成功: 虽然 get_tool_contract(live_trading_manager) 契约标 side_effect=read_only/confirmation_required=false(N01发现), 但运行时 submit_order(execute=true) 被 risk_guard.require_confirmation_if_needed 拦截, error_code=CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED, 且运行时 meta.side_effect 正确标 level=trade_risk/confirmation_required=true; 护栏在运行时可靠, 契约元数据缺陷不影响实际安全
★★★ 三层护栏纵深防御: (1)写操作默认dry_run=true只预览; (2)execute=true必须配confirm_token=I_UNDERSTAND_THE_RISK否则CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED; (3)即便token正确, 网关write_enabled=false→read_only模式仍只返回预览不下单; 三层任一即可阻止误下单
★★ confirm_token 校验: 错误token(WRONG_TOKEN_123)被拒, 要求精确token值
★★ submit_order/cancel_order dry_run 预览完整且 submitted=false/cancelled=false, 不触达 broker
★ 参数校验完整: 缺symbol/qty/notional/order_id 均明确报错; 非法action列出15个supported
★ gateway_status 暴露完整能力矩阵(read_only/write_enabled/allow_write/capabilities), AI可据此判断写权限
★ sanity_warnings 机制(lot_size检查), notional/limit/market/buy/sell 多形态预览正确
★ 只读类(account/positions/orders/fills)gateway未配置时优雅报错不伪造
